caption:
Three hotels say "Shinjuku". Which station will you actually use? 🚉

🚄 Near JR Shinjuku: the Narita Express leaves from here (first around 5:55), rooms from about ¥22,000
🛍️ Near Shinjuku-sanchome: exits into Isetan, direct subways to Shibuya, Ikebukuro and Ginza, about ¥15,000
💴 Near Higashi-shinjuku: cheapest at about ¥13,000, but Fukutoshin Line expresses don't stop
(Double room for two, same Wednesday night in December)

Our pick: Shinjuku-sanchome for most trips; pay for the JR side only before an early Narita Express.
